items.title: John Casimir Interview, 1959-01-17
items.q: Me and Wood and Joy's band were in the boxing shop... Wood and Joe and Brad went to O'Connor with the human man and gave us there.

ctx.x: That's David. He's the old Tuxedo band. Mm-hmm. Who was in Wood and Joy's band that you were playing with? Me and Wood and Joy's band that you were playing with? Well, me and Wood and Joy's band were in the boxing shop and the bill go.
Wood and Joe and Brad went to O'Connor with the human man and gave us there. Played for the Zulu, you know. Just two corners.
But you just had four pieces with Wood and Joe then. Yeah.
